newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST- Cultor 8-mth profit seen lower.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST- Cultor 8-mth profit seen lower.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 231 million markka median forecast for foodstuffs, animal feed and bakery group Cultor Oy's January-August profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on October 8.
In January-August 1995, Cultor posted a 336 million markka profit.
For Cultor's full-year 1996 profit, 11 of the 13 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 413 million markka (mean 409 million) in a 336-490 million markka range.
The data was collected in the fourth week of September and on October 4.

Contributors to the survey were ABB Aros Securities, AG Private Bankers, Alfred Berg, Aktia Bank, Carnegie, Enskilda, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita Securities, and Opstock Securities.
